cases.reasoning: Tie: both explain the asynchronous lifecycle and distinguish the documented contract from unresolved production decisions. Both preserve all four states, retention/link uncertainty, capacity limits, cancellation exclusion, access control, retry/idempotency, and dependency gaps without inventing implementation details. A explicitly warns against inferring idempotency; B also warns against assuming automatic worker retry. These are useful, supported elaborations of the same uncertainty, and both are ready-to-use explanations.

summary.dimension_applicability: Edit restraint is not scored: these are generation tasks with source notes, not edits of supplied finished prose. Preservation of useful detail and uncertainty is scored under fidelity and reader relevance.

exact_checks.criterion: At most 170 words including subject and sign-off

summary.word_count_method: Whitespace-delimited words; all outputs also pass using word-like token counts.
summary.unsupported_claim_review: No unsupported specifications, personal circumstances, measured savings, success guarantees, discounts or fulfillment commitments were found. The absence of a staff-time baseline supports the time-saving limitation; unresolved retry and repeated-submission notes support the production cautions.
summary.evaluation_feedback: The 301 and 303 assertion lists omit their explicit word limits; independent exact checks above cover them. No substantive assertion gap was observed.
summary.interpretation: These ties establish equivalent usable output on the reviewed cases, not demonstrated improvement or population-level superiority.
